title: Final Soil learner decomposition-hold layer

changes.sourceEnglish: Soil contains many kinds of living organisms. Bacteria and fungi help break down organic matter and cycle nutrients.
changes.before: Mobung ho na le mefuta e mengata ya dintho tse phelang. Baktheria le fungi di thusa ho qhaqha organic matter le ho tsamaisa dimatlafatsi ka potoloho.
changes.after: Mobung ho na le mefuta e mengata ya dintho tse phelang. Baktheria le fungi di thusa ho break down organic matter le ho tsamaisa dimatlafatsi ka potoloho.

changes.sourceEnglish: Compost is organic matter broken down under managed conditions.
changes.before: Compost ke organic matter e qhaqhollwang ka tsela e laolwang.
changes.after: Compost ke organic matter e broken down ka tsela e laolwang.

changes.sourceEnglish: Soil contains many kinds of living organisms. Bacteria and fungi help break down organic matter and cycle nutrients.
changes.before: Mavu a na mifuda minzhi ya living organisms. Bacteria na fungi dzi thusa u kwashekanya organic matter na u cycle nutrients.
changes.after: Mavu a na mifuda minzhi ya living organisms. Bacteria na fungi dzi thusa u break down organic matter na u cycle nutrients.

changes.sourceEnglish: Soil contains many kinds of living organisms. Bacteria and fungi help break down organic matter and cycle nutrients.
changes.before: Misava yi na tinxaka to tala ta swilo leswi hanyaka. Bacteria na fungi swi pfuna ku fayelela organic matter ni ku cycle nutrients.
changes.after: Misava yi na tinxaka to tala ta swilo leswi hanyaka. Bacteria na fungi swi pfuna ku break down organic matter ni ku cycle nutrients.

changes.sourceEnglish: Liquid that drains naturally from a worm bin is called leachate. It is not the same as a prepared worm-casting tea.
changes.before: Mokelikeli o itshollang ka tlhaho ho tswa ho worm bin o bitswa leachate. Ha o tshwane le worm-casting tea e lokisitsweng.
changes.after: Mokedikedi o itshollang ka tlhaho ho tswa ho worm bin o bitswa leachate. Ha o tshwane le worm-casting tea e lokisitsweng.
